CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.

4. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   C. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

11. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

12. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
